#  11893 - Internship Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11893 - module is no longer offered from WS 2024/25**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Internship**  |  
|  Industriepraktikum   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Panchenko, Andriy 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students acquire the ability to solve a subtask of a larger project in a professional environment and to document the results. In particular the students become acquainted with work processes and group organization in professional environments.They learn to apply their acquired practical and theoretical knowledge in the working world and to assess the relevance of scientific approaches.  |  
| Contents:  | A time-limited task in the field of cyber security is handled in an external facility. The task is assigened by the external facility in agreement between the student's mentor and the external supervisor.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | The first year of study should be successfully completed.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Practical training / 220 Hours 
  * Research paper/essay / 20 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Working materials, references, documentation will be provided by supervising facility.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Internship report

The internship report has to be delivered not later than 8 weeks after completion of the internship. It is examined by the student's mentor.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Study Performance – ungraded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Cyber Security M.Sc.: Mandatory module

 |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 05.01.2024 

 |
